steps.title: Show the open, empty box
steps.action: Place the open box under the camera with nothing inside.

steps.title: Position the divider
steps.action: Lay the book across the middle of the box as the divider, then approve the two zones.

steps.action: Place the mouse and the highlighter in the top compartment.

steps.title: Pack the bottom compartment
steps.action: Place the bundled cable and the power bank in the bottom compartment.

steps.title: Inspect before closing
steps.action: Keep the lid open and take one photo of the whole interior.
